summary: Cost/execution book specification for Track B cohort-1 (BTCUSDT spot-perp delta-neutral cash-and-carry, shared 100k book, unlevered, taker-only). Component inventory with evidence classes: 5 MEASURED-path (spot/perp fill-hour conditional spreads, slippage-if-replay, settled funding series, hedge drift), 4 DECLARED-required (spot fees, perp fees, margin brackets model, outage/reopen band; slippage fallback), 3 BLOCKED (liquidation tape, maker/queue fills, top-of-book depth capacity) plus program-wide borrow/levered forms and second venue. No local Binance fee-schedule or margin-bracket document exists in the repo (verified by search), so fee tiers and MMR brackets carry DECLARED-required status with exact validation steps (sha-pin venue-published schedules in the data gate, reconcile to fills) — no tier number is stated as verified (Q-8). Census law specified per P-27/Q-2: per-(leg, utc_hour, month) spread histograms with persisted bucket counts, LOW_SAMPLE_BUCKET (n<30) and EXCLUDED_BUCKET (n<10) flags, percentiles only from persisted counts, global p50 inadmissible; funding settlement rows persisted with sign x regime histograms. 100k book arithmetic: recommended N=65,000 spot notional 1:1 perp short, M=35,000 margin (35% of book), re-margin trigger at margin<20% of N (adverse move ~+33.8%), force-exit band at <12% (~+41.8%), declared-model liquidation ~49-53% minus DECLARED MMR; funding-path stress: at measured p=24.7% negative in-downtrend, a 3-negative-settlement run is EXPECTED per 42-day hold (E~1.9), one 5-run budgeted, worst-path 5x30bps = 150 bps of N ~ 1.0% of book = PnL drag, not solvency event. F-5 law: anchor math verified exactly (20-25 bps RT / 1.11 bps/day in-DT = 18-23 days; x1.5 = 27-34 days) and extended to the mandated x2.0 operative ceiling 36-45 days; KILL_COST_CEILING inequality preregistered (mechanism killed iff every frozen (premium, hold) pair has expected_carry < 2.0xRT_conditional + outage band); corrections recorded (worst settlement = 1.2-1.5 full RTs vs the plan's '2.5 fee round-trips' one-way unit; utilization x0.65 must appear in book-level attribution; full-window mean 3.23 bps/day inadmissible for gating). Honest all-in band held: 20-25 bps at x1 only after fee validation, operative x2.0 stressed ceiling 40-50 bps + declared outage band => all-in ~45-60 bps of N. Clearing verdict at anchors: YES only for >=6-8 week positive-funding-regime holds; in-downtrend conditional carry sits AT the ceiling (knife-edge, P-2) — KILL_COST_CEILING must stay armed and in-downtrend entries die unless the frozen entry premium band measurably exceeds the stressed bill.
known_limitations: Fee-tier and maintenance-bracket numbers are NOT stated anywhere in this deliverable as verified: no local venue fee/bracket document exists in the repo (searched); they are DECLARED-required with exact validation steps. The 20-25 bps anchor remains program-law until the fee schedule is sha-pinned and reconciled to fills.

Spread/slippage/drift components are MEASURED-path but the census data is not yet staged in this lane; all such components are BLOCKED-for-scoring until the Track B data gate stages bookTicker/aggTrades and the census lands.

Conditional magnitude of NEGATIVE funding settlements is a declared band today (only the worst anchor -0.30%/8h is measured); the funding census must persist the negative-magnitude distribution before funding-path stress uses anything beyond the worst anchor.
Margin path assumes no cross-collateral transfer of spot gains into perp margin without trading (declared simulation rule); a venue feature allowing it would only improve the band, not invalidate it.

Run-expectation arithmetic assumes settlement-sign independence within downtrend regimes; serial correlation would make long negative runs MORE likely — the declared 5-run budget is therefore a floor, not a ceiling.

Pre-existing untracked files at the root checkout (.zcode/, plan_at.md, other control dirs, the Track B draft plan itself) were present at lane start and untouched; tree_status reflects deliverables-only writes from this lane.
Lane is outcome-blind by design: no scored results, ledgers, or terminal PnL files were read; anchors were cross-checked only against plan text and registry/audit citations.
incidents: None raised. No orders, no trading endpoints, no API keys, no S1 access, no commits, no ledger writes, no process interference.
